Ninja Catalogue

A focused catalogue for Orb Arena combatants. Import/export stays in HTML, and legacy details are preserved when you edit an existing ninja.

Keep only the information useful for Orb Arena visible: combat identity, loadout, special abilities, and D100 stats. HTML import/export preserves the complete record, including legacy fields hidden from this streamlined editor.
Permanent Arena Roster — 32 Season 1 Ninja · 29 Sensei · 28 Enemies

These characters are embedded in this HTML, not dependent on browser storage or catalogue imports. Choose them directly in the Arena's fighter dropdowns. A saved copy can be edited or recruited to a Season 2 squad without affecting the original.

🍥 Season 2 — Ninja Squads

16 teams · 3 permanent ninja per team · manually recruit returning Season 1 fighters or reassign any saved ninja.

Loading Season 2 squads…

Recruit returning Season 1 fighters by importing an older Catalogue or saving a character from the Character Log below. Full squads cannot receive extra members; moving or unassigning a ninja frees their old slot. Populated squads can enter the Team Tournament, including squads with only one or two members. Tournament winners are recorded manually; Arena fights are launched separately.
